scripts.start: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "if (Test-Path ..\venv\Scripts\python.exe) { ..\venv\Scripts\python -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --reload } else { python -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --reload }"
scripts.test: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "if (Test-Path ..\venv\Scripts\python.exe) { ..\venv\Scripts\python -m pytest tests -v } else { python -m pytest tests -v }"
